fields.acceptance_criteria: board_check_in accepts a way to claim a non-file scope (e.g. a topic/epic-authoring lock keyed by parent ticket id or topic label) in addition to owned_files; a second agent attempting to check in the same topic/epic-authoring scope is blocked with a conflict error analogous to the existing file-conflict error; WIP-limit and stale-entry semantics apply to topic locks the same way they apply to file ownership; ticket/spec authoring guidance (workflow.instructions.md, board.instructions.md) documents when to claim a topic lock versus file ownership; a regression test reproduces the duplicate-track incident (two concurrent agents authoring the same epic/ticket set) and shows the second check-in is rejected
fields.title: [ticket-workflow] Board check-in should support claiming ticket-authoring/topic scope, not just implementation files
